## Summary

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link related issues where relevant.

## Validation

List commands/checks run and their results, or explain why a check was not run.
For documentation changes, verify examples, links, and CLI defaults.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Changes are focused and follow the existing project style.
- [ ] Behavior changes have appropriate deterministic, keyless tests (or an explanation).
- [ ] Relevant documentation and the Unreleased changelog are updated (or not applicable).
- [ ] Shared output and fixtures contain no credentials or private data.

## Risks or limitations

Note compatibility, dependency, freshness, or data-handling changes, if any.
